does: For every creature with a newly added stealth request it walks the participants of that creature's fight (the array at +0x50 of eoc::combat::StateComponent) and puts into the set each one whose relation to the creature is 100 and who is not surprised already.

evidence.says: the Toolkit's EoCServer.dll exports the name, with the same loop in the export's body
the query is active, participant and stealth request, newly added; the ally test is the helper's IsAllied (relation equal to 100); the skip is code:unplaced::IsSurprisedOrAskedToBe
a count-only probe on that check shows 2 calls from inside this function in a fight of one target and one ally; the ally gets the join request, a target with Alert keeps its ally surprised
